body:
## Red-team review and saved replanning decision
Saved revision 3 (`rv_01m6t4set2vr08t8032tmrx604`) replaces the former three-sprint plan with ONE sprint, 15 preserved work tickets and sole final acceptance DM-449. The epic remains Backlog; no run or ticket attempt was started. DM-456/DM-461 were redundant acceptance nodes, not lost implementation work.

The old detail level was not execution-ready: all 15 work tickets had empty structured references/artifacts, and all three acceptance bodies were empty (their criteria were NOT empty). Four independent read-only lenses reviewed code/native lifecycle, contracts/security, test honesty/gates and product/activity; each then cross-checked its revised slice. Findings are plan gaps/design risks, not alleged implemented-feature exploits.

### Material findings and assigned resolutions
- DM-452/459: existing TerminalSessions.paste schedules Enter and may start/resume a CLI. Add a separate acknowledged live-generation no-submit insertion; preserve kickoff/Kick-back submitting behavior. Timer-complete/raw-PTY and actual clipboard proof are required.
- DM-450: layout requires shared schema -> ChatStore -> ChatRecords -> validated IPC/preload -> renderer, not a record-field shortcut. Preserve single xterm/PTY/headless-screen resize authority, small-window behavior, focus and per-chat restart persistence. Corrected coordinator suspicion: chatStore.ts is still a real persistence owner.
- DM-451/453/454: attachment inspection/roots/protocol/CSP and xterm URL/OSC8/clipboard/grapheme support already landed. Reuse them, remove conditional duplicate-parser/no-protocol/no-link claims. Images for visual proof must be real encodings, not existing minimal-header parser fixtures. Link positions need wrapped display-cell/grapheme mapping; hover is nonmutating and race-safe.
- DM-453: scope immutable bounded file snapshots, token registry/revocation and trusted-session protocol; distinguish metadata size/text. Revalidate human local-system opening via separate token operation because current openExternal is URL-only. Raw vendor-home activity files cannot bypass masking via viewer. Preserve original broad allowed roots explicitly: eligible system-temp files are NOT per-chat filesystem confidentiality.
- DM-455: registered app-window identity must supplement URL/main-frame trust; hostile browser loading app dev origin gains no IPC. Session navigation/permission/download policy covers redirect/popup/programmatic paths. Counted shared occlusion leases own nested DOM/native menus/dialogs/previews and mounted sign-in; windows/view generations and native bounds have explicit owners.
- DM-457: Node default Windows pipe ACL is not a user-exclusive transport guarantee. Use bounded authenticated local IPC and current usable pane.control grant bound to live chat/window/terminal generation, never historical IDs. Revalidate every direct socket request and before publication. Shared 20s server deadline INCLUDES queue time, 25s client total, <=15s load within remaining budget; disconnect/revocation/exit cancels queued/inflight work. No automatic retry or token-bearing logs.
- DM-458/459: capture implementation must include native child browser pixels, exact intended surface/crop and scale; native probe selects a strategy but cannot replace working bitmap composition. Background/wrong-chat/overlay/stale targets refuse instead of focus theft or photographing another chat. Whole-window AGENT capture is human opt-in per live chat, owned by toolbar consent control; direct human capture remains available. One capture service feeds UI and commands.
- DM-462/463/464: provider evidence and session-generation identity, supported/partial/unsupported/not_verified plus health, unknown fields, final-report versus last-message, parent/status/usage provenance, incremental UTF-8/replay/replacement/polling, retention/cursors/limits and mask-before-truncate projections are explicit. Local Claude metadata and Codex Desktop rollouts exist; this does not establish executable version or CLI parity.
- DM-465: validated attempt/structured leading key replaces first-mentioned-ticket guessing. Ambiguity/foreign/retry state remains visible and observational; new Kanban Activity UI and explicit agent deep links are owned, preserving authoritative attempt timelines.
- DM-466: original conditional Codex adapter scope retained, with REQUIRED evidence-backed support resolution. Usable source requires adapter implementation; missing auth/CLI does not prove absent records. No added Autonomous/OMP/Cursor/custom adapter obligations.
- DM-460/449: docs now follow ALL feature branches and actual generated instructions. Final node covers every work ticket and owns portable scratch-profile driver plus independent actual Electron/packaged Windows/macOS, clipboard, native ABI/compositor, hostile-page, transport/lifecycle, provider and docs sweeps.

### Testing cadence and proof
Preserved no mandatory tests-first and no Fireguard grading. Workers own listed targeted behavioral tests/smoke plus lint/typecheck for changed code. Full project DoD runs at final combined acceptance: lint, typecheck, npm test, coverage, deadcode, build. Both test and coverage are required by current DoD; Fireguard own tests inside npm test are not grading. Corrected SDET initial coverage omission before saving.
Required runtime executors/scaling and authorized live Claude verification are entry prerequisites; an unavailable required witness is NOT a passed-with-caveat result. Synthetic fixture proof must not masquerade as live no-permission/provider/native evidence. Failures are repaired inside this sprint, not silently deferred.

### Verification and limitations
Executed actual CLI capabilities/discovery and draft mutation/validation/save/readback. Server validation has no errors; sole intentional warning is large DM-449, justified as one pinned combined acceptance sweep. Structural readback confirms one sprint, same 15 work IDs, one acceptance, all source/artifact/test/effort metadata, and complete 15-ticket covers mapping. Save returned durable status saved. No product code/test/build/runtime execution occurred during planning, so native/platform/provider assumptions remain named IMPLEMENTATION proof obligations, not currently proven feature behavior. No commit was made; unrelated dirty process/board edits were untouched.
